name: rgb_matrix
description: 8x8 WS2812B/NeoPixel LED matrix driver. Supports pixel-level control, bitmap rendering, screen rotation, and brightness. Three indexing styles: set_color(), [x,y]=, [x][y]=.

properties.name: brightness
properties.description: Global brightness 0.0-1.0. Setting re-renders entire matrix.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fill entire matrix with one color

parameters.name: immediate
parameters.description: If False, only update buffer (call write() later)

methods.name: write
methods.description: Flush buffer to hardware (after batched set_color with immediate=False)

magic_methods.name: __setitem__
magic_methods.signature: screen[x, y] = color or screen[x][y] = color

example:
from machine import Pin
from rgb_matrix import RGBMatrix
from colors import RED, GREEN, BLUE

screen = RGBMatrix(Pin(4), rotation=0)
screen[3, 3] = GREEN
screen.fill(RED)
screen.clear()
screen.brightness = 0.5
screen.deinit()
esp32_notes: Coordinates (x, y) must be 0-7. Out-of-range raises ValueError.
rotation must be 0, 90, 180, or 270. Other values raise ValueError.
Three indexing styles all work: set_color([x,y], c), screen[x,y] = c, screen[x][y] = c
Batch updates with immediate=False + write() at the end is ~10x faster than per-pixel writes
WS2812B needs precise timing — only certain pins work reliably. GPIO 4-5 are typically OK.
hardware_notes: 8x8 WS2812B matrix: 5V power, GND, DIN signal. Full-white draws ~3A — external 5V supply required.
Add 1000μF capacitor across power pins for stability
Data line: 470Ω resistor in series, close to matrix DIN
differences_from_standard_mp: Standard NeoPixel API only exposes single-pixel ops. RGBMatrix adds 2D indexing, bitmap, and rotation.
